name: v3.12.0
body: 3.12.0 adds seven themes, a text size setting, and gain and loss colours for markets where red means up. The phone app now keeps a stack of screens for each tab, the dashboard and Insights share one time period, and a rebalancing worksheet works out adjustments from your allocation target. Fund conversions, new price sources and AI agent access to Spending round it out, with fixes across spending, goals, performance, import and mobile. ## Highlights - **Themes.** Seven new themes join Classic: Signature, Ember, Cupertino, Newspaper, Cyber, Terminal and Poster. Pick one in Settings → Appearance or during setup. The theme is saved per device; new profiles start on Signature and existing ones keep Classic. Charts follow the theme, and Classic's charts now use softer colours. (#2305, #2360, #2361) - **Text size.** Settings → Appearance → Text size: Small, Default, Large or Extra large, on this device. On iPhone and Android the app starts from the system text size. (#2323) - **Gain and loss colours.** Choose Red up, green down or Red up, blue down, as in China, Taiwan, South Korea and Japan. Green up stays the default. (#2326) - **Phone navigation.** Each tab of the bottom bar keeps its own stack of screens, so going back returns to the screen as you left it. Swipe from the left edge to go back on iPhone; Android's Back button steps back through the tab. Holdings joins the bar, which is a full-width Material bar on Android. (#2287, #2290, #2295, #2384) - **One time period.** The period you pick on the dashboard or in Insights carries over to the other tabs, and Investments and Net Worth get Spending's calendar picker. (#2285) - **Rebalancing worksheet.** It replaces the Rebalance planner: open a target's details and choose **Open rebalancing**. Pick the cash to deploy, accounts and eligible securities, adjust the suggested trades, then copy or export them. Nothing is executed. (#1612) - **Fund conversions.** Record a fund switch, a share-class conversion or a fund-to-ETF conversion as **Fund conversion**: the new units keep the old ones' cost and dates, and nothing is sold. (#2336) - **More price sources.** A provider catalog in Settings → Market data, with **AMFI** for Indian mutual funds and the **Moscow Exchange**, both off until you add them. Custom providers get a TMX Money template and POST requests. (#2367, #2356, #2365, #2380, #2386, #1800, #1916) - **Spending for AI agents.** Three new permissions, View spending, Organize spending and Manage budgets, let an agent read and organize your spending and budgets. Changes are shown for review before they're saved. (#2251, #2296) - **Retirement and savings goals share accounts.** A savings goal can take part of an account Retirement uses; the retirement chart marks each goal. (#2398) ## Upgrading - Nothing is recalculated on first launch, and existing profiles keep their look (Classic and Mono). (#2361) - **AI agent access:** existing tokens keep exactly their permissions. An agent that used the categorization tools needs View spending, plus Organize spending to make changes: edit the token in Settings → AI agent access and reconnect the agent. **Activities — commit/write** now also allows deleting and voiding activities. (#2135, #2296) - **Synced devices:** update them all before you change gain and loss colours, record a fund conversion, or let a savings goal share an account with Retirement. Devices still on 3.11 don't handle them correctly. If one received a conversion while on 3.11, open that account after updating and choose **Recalculate History**. (#2326, #2336, #2398) - **Savings goals** may show a different status or monthly amount: the expected return is now a yearly rate, as in the retirement planner, and a goal with no saved plan assumes 5% instead of 7%. (#2378) - Self-hosting needs no configuration changes. Docker images are tagged `3.12.0`, `3.12` and `latest`; if you pin `3.11`, change it to `3.12`. - **Add-on developers** (details in the SDK changelog): - Pages follow the user's theme, text size and gain colours: `Settings` fields, `data-*` attributes on ``, and new `--gain`, `--loss` and chart tokens. Classic's `--chart-*` values changed. (#2305, #2323, #2326) - New Spending functions each need their own grant, and `searchCashActivities()` returns split amounts as decimal strings. (#2296) - Imports can record fund conversions with `ACTIVITY_SUBTYPES`, now exported as values; add-ons that use them need `minWealthfolioVersion` 3.12.0. (#2336, #2413) - **Contributors:** run `pnpm install`; frontend checks now use TypeScript 7, Oxlint and Oxfmt. (#2303) ## Improvements - **Spending:** a Spending tab in Insights, a grid for editing many transactions at once, categories you can move under another parent, a tree picker with icons, and an Italian categorization preset. (#2311, #2374, #2294, #2292, #2250, #2289) - **Account numbers** for manual accounts, such as an IBAN; CSV import matches against them. (#2339, #2343) - **Import:** skip rows in the Mapping step. (#2270) - **AI agent access:** agents see more fields, record taxes and FX rates, can delete or void activities, and can run the Health Center's checks. (#2135) - **Look and feel:** lighter dashboard balances, pale activity badges, compact holdings tables, account chart markers and consistent Settings pages. (#2305, #2312, #2333, #2338, #2342, #2360, #2377) - **Language:** built-in classifications, categories, notifications and validation messages follow the app language. (#2246, #2298, #2355, #2362) - **Self-hosting:** `WF_OIDC_CA_FILE` trusts a private CA for OIDC only. (#2253, #2324, #2413) ## Fixes - **Spending:** transfers back from savings now count, shown as **Net saved**, so Net no longer reads too low. Credits imported without a subtype are listed. The highest-priority rule that fits each transaction now applies, and re-running rules reports what actually changed and says why a rule couldn't apply. (#2328, #2368, #2402) - **Goals:** a goal's health, status and chart agree everywhere, and removing a target date removes it. (#2340, #2378) - **Performance:** a 5Y or 1Y range covering all history matches ALL, cash back and refunds count as income, and the custom range opens at your earliest data. (#2382, #2254, #1617) - **Activities:** totals are saved as entered, price fields take 8 decimals, and amount fields use the currency's decimals. (#2375, #2379) - **Import:** re-importing trades by symbol or ID no longer duplicates them, and the Mapping step's previews and column matching behave better. (#2302, #2009, #2015, #2352, #2283, #2267) - **Mobile:** swiping between tabs no longer stalls, switching an account's tabs on iPhone no longer scrolls the page up, and a link to an asset's tab opens it. (#2384, #2259, #2413) - **Desktop and Settings:** profile settings scroll again, the menu bar follows each profile on Windows and Linux, long Settings lists and the sidebar no longer show extra scroll bars, and the web app no longer shows the desktop-only **Show menu bar** switch. (#2399, #2252, #2327, #2413, #2392) - **Health and limits:** Friday's FX rates aren't flagged as stale over the weekend, and dated contribution limits count their first and last days. (#2396, #2401) - **Also fixed:** the net worth **New** label, hidden-balance symbols, Insights cards emptied by an account filter, Treasury bond prices, Connect rate limits, copy buttons over HTTP, add-on zips from Windows or over 1.5 MiB, and update dialog images on narrow screens. A sold lot's holding period now ends on its sale date, and a new fund saved as a mutual fund from the holdings editor or an add-on is classified as one. The add-on permission prompt names every function and detects `alternativeAssets.getAll`, and on the web server a cancelled profile start no longer makes the next request fail with "Cannot acquire database ownership". (#2256, #2360, #2330, #2277, #2387, #2341, #2251, #2307, #2322, #2413, #2404, #2403, #2393, #2414, #2410) - **Security:** dependency updates for zod, body-parser, undici and zip (add-on installs), two more eMudhra roots distrusted, and the Docker image on Alpine 3.24. (#2291, #2298, #2423, #2297, #2383) Thanks to everyone who contributed and reported issues, including @AleksandrZhukov, @alexghirelli, @amanda-wee, @bakiba, @Baykenn, @blastik, @chiliec, @daviddphillips, @dddd-zdf, @dpremoli, @draeron, @FJiayang, @gitlappi, @jay-tau, @Jonjon-prog, @kdamiani, @kryofin, @kwaich, @lhewett946, @ridoli, @shkarinn, @SpoiledSneeze, @TapuGithub, @unstoppablesssss and @Zanderama. **Full changelog:** https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.11.0...v3.12.0

name: v3.11.0
body: 3.11.0 adds running balances, Arabic with a right-to-left layout, per-currency number formats and currency exchanges within an account. The interface is rebuilt on new foundations, and many calculation, income and sync issues are fixed. ## Highlights - **Running balances.** Cash and credit-card accounts show the balance after each activity, so you can check imports against a bank statement. Spending → Transactions shows it too when the list covers one account. Other transaction-tracked accounts show their end-of-day cash in each day's header. Activity exports and the AI tools include the balance. (#2028, #2038, #2049) - **Activity lists grouped by day.** The Activities page and an account's Activities tab open each day with a header, like Spending's transactions. (#2139, #2088) - **Arabic**, with a right-to-left layout across the app and add-ons. (#2177, #2186, #2192, #2193, #2203, #2210) - **Per-currency number formats.** In Settings → General → Language & Region, **Customize currency formats** lets a currency follow another region: INR can use Indian grouping (₹12,34,567.89) while USD stays in US format. Amounts also show each currency's own decimals: none for JPY, three for KWD. (#1970, #2026, #2061, #2062, #2108, #2110, #2114, #2137) - **Currency exchange within one account.** A cash transfer can go from one currency to another in the same account. It is saved as a linked pair and doesn't count as a contribution. (#2036, #2044) - **Loan rate changes.** Record a lender's new rate, with or without a new payment, without renewing the loan: **Change interest rate** in the Schedule tab's **Add event** menu. (#2240, #2243) - **Refreshed interface.** The UI is rebuilt on new foundations (Base UI). Tables and grids sit on cards, menus and pickers are consistent, and keyboard focus is clearer. Buttons, switches and pickers that had no accessible name now have one, in every language. (#2154, #2234, #2206, #2225, #2242) - **AI assistant** works with current Claude, GPT and Gemini models, which rejected some of its requests before. CSV imports read the attached file itself, so files up to the 500-row limit import whole, and pasted tables work too. The prompt stays the same through a conversation, so providers can cache it. (#2047, #2078, #2086, #2140) - **AI Agent Access** has ready-to-copy setup for Claude Code, Codex and the ChatGPT desktop app, Cursor and other MCP apps, and labels each tool read-only or write. (#2075) ## Upgrading - There is no migration, and nothing is recalculated on first launch. - Run **Refresh full history** once (Settings → Market Data → History) if, on 3.10.0, you had any of these: credits marked external, such as refunds or reimbursements from bank sync; custom holdings of type "Other"; currency conversions imported as a transfer pair within one account; or cash or holdings in a currency whose code isn't three letters, such as USDT. Until then, past values in those accounts stay as 3.10.0 calculated them. (#2018, #2025, #2036, #2175) - Some numbers change. Income is converted at the exchange rate of the day it was received, and counted in its month in your time zone; it used today's rate and UTC months. Performance now includes currency gains and losses on cash. (#2100, #2172, #2211) - In rare cases, the first broker sync after updating sets a holding's average cost to 0, even a cost you edited. It takes a broker that doesn't send an average cost and a quantity with three or more decimals, such as 4096.029. (#2027) - If you use device sync, update all your devices. Older versions keep rejecting some edits, such as a renamed portfolio or a changed category. If an edit, manual price or import mapping never reached another device, edit it again or pair that device again. (#2098, #2079, #2080) - Self-hosting needs no configuration changes. Docker images are tagged `3.11.0`, `3.11` and `latest`; if you pin `3.10`, change it to `3.11`. - **Add-on developers:** `@wealthfolio/ui` now follows Base UI's API (`render` instead of `asChild`, Base UI state attributes, `Select` items and more; see the SDK changelog). Add-ons built for earlier SDKs keep working through deprecated adapters. (#2154) - **Linux packagers:** the in-app updater no longer installs over AUR, Flatpak or other package-manager installs. It still shows the update and its notes, and leaves the install to the package manager. Set `WEALTHFOLIO_UPDATE_EXPLANATION` to show your own message. (#2008) ## Improvements - **Holdings snapshots:** enter either the total cost or the cost per share; the other is calculated. (#1992) - **Cash balances:** adjust an account's cash one currency at a time, so a change to its USD cash records a USD deposit or withdrawal. (#2181) - **Settings:** Region & formats is searchable. (#2234) - **Spending:** row checkboxes appear on hover, and a partial selection shows a dash. (#2088) - **Tables:** the Holdings, Securities and Activities column headers stay in view while you scroll. (#2145, #2148) - **Options:** strikes show in the option's quote currency. (#2057, #2144) - **macOS:** Cmd+C, Cmd+V and Cmd+Z keep working, because the menu now stays installed; the Show menu bar setting is hidden on macOS. (#2095) - **Linux:** Undo, Redo, Quit and the Edit menu work. (#2021) - **Windows:** the Wealthfolio menu no longer has Hide, which could leave the window hidden, or the always-disabled Hide Others and Show All. (#2090) - **Links:** old `/income` and `/performance` bookmarks open their Insights tabs. (#2159) ## Fixes - **Device sync:** manual prices and valuations, CSV import mappings, and items deleted and re-created (portfolio edits, category changes, tags, budgets, holdings snapshots) now reach your other devices. A device catches up when the cloud is ahead of it, and keeps receiving changes while an upload waits to retry. (#2079, #2080, #2098, #2236, #2238) - **Calculations:** credits marked external, such as refunds and reimbursements, count as contributions again instead of gains. Custom "Other" holdings are counted once in net worth. Performance includes currency gains and losses on cash, also in securities accounts, and marks a partial result "Partial data". Recalculating history on large accounts no longer fails with "too many SQL variables". Conversions at past dates accept codes such as USDT. (#2018, #2024, #2025, #2211, #2223, #2176, #2175) - **Income:** converted at the rate on the day it was received, and counted in its month in your time zone. Income without an exchange rate is left out of totals, and a notice names the currency. The currency pie compares converted amounts. Growth shows nothing instead of 0% when there is nothing to compare, and keeps its decimals. (#2100, #2172, #2089, #2077, #2153, #2158) - **Activities:** editing a trade keeps its security, instead of sometimes creating a duplicate asset. A pasted or typed symbol no longer keeps the previous security's name, currency and price source. Editing one side of a synced transfer keeps the other side's date and reference. The cash ledger no longer shows some sells as outflows in currencies such as HUF and IDR. (#2209, #2190, #2241, #2041, #2137) - **Settings:** a rejected settings update no longer changes the base currency, and the base currency must be a currency code. (#2046, #2200) - **Hide Balance** also hides the amounts in the income currency pie's tooltip and on the income chart's axes, and Spending's budget pace, ring tooltips and chart average. (#2074, #2101) - **Connect:** broker numbers are converted exactly; 4196049.73 no longer becomes 4196049.730000001. (#2027) - **Desktop:** on Linux, the window no longer freezes or stays blank while the keyring is slow or waits for an unlock prompt, and startup says why a profile couldn't open. Long history reads (net worth, health checks, holdings) no longer block the window or other requests. The start page no longer runs out of memory with many accounts on WebKitGTK 2.54. Scrollbars are no longer hidden under sticky headers. (#2064, #2076, #2168, #2174, #2197, #2207, #2171, #2011, #2081, #2111, #2173) - **Web app:** saving a CSV import template works when the browser doesn't provide `crypto.randomUUID`, for example on a self-hosted server opened over plain HTTP. Buttons along the top edge of a page work in the web app and on phones. (#2237, #2160) - **Mobile:** Next in Spending's Add Transaction no longer saves a $0 transaction, the Performance Plus button stays on screen, and period rows scroll sideways. The currency picker says "Choose a currency". On iOS, portfolios created before 3.9 open after an app update (also in iOS 3.10.1). (#2232, #2045, #2039) - **AI assistant:** a reply cut off by a provider error is saved. Images in replies show as text instead of loading, so a prompt injection can't send data out through an image address. (#2163, #2029) - **Security:** TLS certificates are updated after the eMudhra CA compromise, and Tauri is updated to 2.12.5 with its plugins. (#2227, #2239) - **Other:** tablet layout fixes, plus test and CI improvements. (#2179, #2242, #2143, #2051, #2097, #2132, #2133, #2164, #2169, #2178, #2185, #2194, #2198) Thanks to everyone who contributed and reported issues, including @jay-tau, @tiann, @Neallin-917, @jesuspb2, @bjmc, @abdulamalik, @salmonumbrella, @Ahmeed1123, @IsThisThingStillOn, @Roy75117, @EduardoSantanaSeverino, @varvaroidragos-cmyk, @marceluk, @Mohammad-Alavi, @rangerqu, @glendon-spark and @toomyem. **Full changelog:** https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.10.0...v3.11.0

name: v3.10.0
body: 3.10.0 introduces a new calculation engine and adds cost basis methods, loan tracking and encrypted cloud backups. ## Highlights - **New portfolio engine.** Holdings, cash, valuations and returns now come from one engine on desktop, mobile and the server. It fixes many edge cases in transfers, shorts, splits, FX and rounding. (#1847, #1875, #1880, #1894, #1897, #1905, #1923, #1990) - **Cost basis methods.** Each transaction-tracked account can use FIFO, weighted average cost (WAC), LIFO or HIFO. Not yet supported: cross-account ACB and picking specific lots. (#1872, #1898, #1904) - **Loans and mortgages.** A liability can be tracked as a loan, with an amortization schedule, payments from a cash account, extra repayments, renewals and confirmed balances. (#1868, #1869, #1888, #1895, #1900, #1903, #1909, #1991) - **Encrypted cloud backups** for Wealthfolio Connect subscribers: a daily backup of one profile, plus **Back up now**. Backups are encrypted before upload, so the cloud only sees ciphertext, and can be up to 256 MiB. Restore works on desktop only; the web server restores with the offline CLI. (#1918, #1980) - **Return of capital** and **notional distributions** adjust cost basis instead of counting as income. (#1902) - **Money flow** chart in Spending Insights. You can zoom into a category's subcategories, and subcategories also show in the spending plan. (#1935, #2004) - **AI agent (MCP) tools** for linking transfers, importing quotes, updating activities and categorizing transactions. (#1896, #1911, #1913, #1937) ## Upgrading - The first launch recalculates your history, after making a backup. On a 13-account portfolio this took about 20 seconds. - Where the old calculation was wrong, some derived numbers can change slightly: cost basis, realized gains and past values. Your activities and prices are not changed. - If you use device sync, update all your devices. 3.9.1 can't calculate accounts set to WAC, LIFO or HIFO, or read the new return-of-capital entries. - Self-hosting needs no configuration changes. ## Improvements - **Activities:** clicking a row opens it for editing. Duplicating an activity uses today's date and keeps its notes. (#1864, #1929) - **CSV import:** investment imports no longer require an Amount column. (#1528, #1979) - **Transfers:** credit card accounts can send cash transfers, and a cash transfer can use a different currency on each side. (#1796, #1901) - **Exchanges** come from the full ISO 10383 list. Four old non-standard exchange codes are updated. (#1828) - **Custom price providers:** new ones apply only to the securities assigned to them. Existing ones keep their fallback. (#1887, #1921) - **Investments dashboard:** filter by a saved portfolio; the choice is remembered per profile. (#1940) - **Hidden accounts** count in their group's total. (#1428, #1882, #1917) - **Health Center** flags accounts with negative cash. (#1926) - **Long performance charts** load faster. (#1930) - **Backups:** a simpler Backups tab. (#1971, #1826) - **Connect** moves above Settings in the desktop sidebar, with links where data is entered by hand. The Sync & Connections page is redesigned around what needs attention. Broker sync requests now include each account's type and the broker's account label, which Connect stores to diagnose mapping problems. (#1984, #1995, #1941) - **Spending:** merchant rules for France, Germany and the Netherlands. (#1829, #1998, #1997) - **Formatting regions:** India, Austria, Romania and Bulgaria are new. (#1968, #1908) - **Windows:** installers are signed (Teymz Inc.). SmartScreen may still warn for a while. (#1910) ## Fixes - **Asset and loan details:** unsaved edits are no longer reset by a background portfolio update. (#1994) - **Linux AppImage:** no longer opens a blank window on distributions with recent Mesa, such as Ubuntu 26.04. It now runs natively on Wayland; set `GDK_BACKEND=x11` to use X11. (#223, #2005) - **Connect:** a brief connection drop no longer signs you out. "Last synced" now shows when sync last ran, not the broker's latest activity date. (#1843, #1995) - **Self-hosted server:** CSV imports over 2 MB (a few thousand rows) no longer fail with `413 Payload Too Large`, and an unusable secrets file gives a clear error. (#2000, #1932, #1886) - **Fund classification:** ETFs no longer show part of their value as Unknown in Sectors. Weights reported above 100% (rounding or leverage) are read correctly, and a fund's sectors are saved together. (#1854, #1855) - **Asset pages:** after a full transfer to another account, income and gains from both accounts are shown, not only the receiving account's. (#1919) - **Accented, Chinese or emoji characters** no longer make some operations fail: AI assistant replies, holdings export, symbol search, and entering or importing activities whose symbol contains them. (#1879) - **Transactions:** the table remembers which columns you show. (#1999) - **Benchmarks:** all-time benchmarks start where your accounts start. (#1933) - **Bonds:** a synced bond reported by CUSIP and by ISIN stays one security. Treasury prices are no longer calculated from incomplete terms. (#1838, #1891) - **Quotes:** the quote CSV import shows the server's error, no longer gets stuck after a failed import, and no longer mixes up two files picked one after the other. An Open, High or Low left untouched saves as the close. (#1950, #1951, #1966, #1973, #1993, #1994) - **Mobile:** Theme "System" follows the phone. Editing a quote keeps focus in the field and saves. (#1959, #1685, #1989) - **Linux:** the app starts with a `C` or `POSIX` locale. (#1726, #1876) - **Desktop:** the database is closed cleanly on exit. (#1890) - **Recovery screen:** when the device's secure storage is locked, it suggests unlocking it and trying again before restoring a backup. (#1996) - **Schwab** "as of" dates import correctly. (#1878) - **Spending:** completed months compare against the full previous month, and savings categories appear in the rule editor. (#1858, #1827) - **AI assistant and MCP:** activities added west of UTC keep their date, and imports report failed rows correctly. (#1892) - **Dependencies:** security updates. (#1899, #1927) - **Other:** fixes to layout, translations, toasts, transfer editing, and navigation after a page error. (#1755, #1798, #1964, #1981, #1846, #1865, #1893, #1928, #1955, #1914) Thanks to everyone who contributed and reported issues, including @jay-tau, @daviddphillips, @theluckystrike, @kryofin, @Jonjon-prog, @Bubbles840, @tiann, @salmonumbrella, @oliviertassinari, @markrickert, @kinhsman, @giovacalle, @bogdanr, @blastik, @Neallin-917, @DamienKCorp and @taufderl. **Full changelog:** https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.9.1...v3.10.0

name: Wealthfolio v3.9.1
body: Bug fixes for device sync, portfolio returns, and startup. - Faster, smaller encrypted device transfers, with broker holdings included and clearer pairing progress. - Consistent holdings-account returns after full and partial recalculations. - Fixed the Linux startup crash caused by native credential storage (#1819). - Clearer self-hosted profile startup errors and recovery from interrupted sessions. Update both devices to 3.9.1 before pairing. If older return history is incorrect, run a full portfolio rebuild. [Full changelog](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.9.0...v3.9.1)

name: v3.9.0
body: 3.9 adds **separate profiles**, app locking, **optional database encryption**, and portable backups. Insights and Spending get more controls, and device setup is simpler. ## Highlights - **Profiles and app lock.** Keep each person’s finances in a separate profile. Set a password, lock after inactivity, and recover access with a recovery code. Existing data remains in a Personal profile. ([#1770](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1770)) - **Encryption and recovery.** Native apps can encrypt their local database. Export password-protected portable backups, preview a backup before restoring it, and recover on another installation. Wealthfolio now makes a verified backup before pending database migrations. Portable restores require you to reconnect external services. ([#1740](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1740), [#1743](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1743)) - **Customizable Insights.** Hide, reorder, and resize overview widgets. New widgets show unrealized P&L, top movers, and concentration. Your layout can sync across devices. ([#1758](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1758)) - **Better Spending controls.** Exclude categories from spending totals, reports, events, and budgets. Choose a custom date range on the Spending dashboard. ([#1635](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1635), [#1512](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1512)) - **Easier device setup.** One guide handles adding, joining, and recovering a device. **Update receiving devices to 3.9 before pairing.** ([#1786](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1786), [#1808](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1808)) ## Self-hosting upgrade notes - **No configuration changes required.** Existing `WF_DB_PATH` and Docker `/data` setups continue to work. Existing data appears in a Personal profile; new profiles use separate databases. `WF_DATA_DIR` is optional. If you set it alongside `WF_DB_PATH`, both must select the same directory. - **Backups now include profiles.** Continue backing up your persistent data directory or Docker volume and your master key. Copying only the original database file will not include additional profiles. Include any custom `WF_SECRET_FILE` or `WF_ADDONS_DIR` location in your backups. - **Encryption stays optional.** `WF_DB_REQUIRE_ENCRYPTION=true` does not convert an existing database. Stop the server, run the offline `db encrypt` command, then enable the requirement. ## More improvements and fixes - **Net worth:** clearer charts when balances cross zero, more useful monthly comparisons, separate portfolio gains from other asset changes, and actions to link properties with mortgages. ([#1807](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1807), [#1801](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1801)) - **Imports:** better detection of two-digit and named-month dates, plus automatic matching of CSV account values to existing accounts. ([#1622](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1622), [#1764](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1764), [#1771](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1771)) - **Prices and performance:** price refreshes preserve older quote history; a separate confirmed action can reset provider history. Latest valuations refresh correctly, and volatility uses the actual frequency of the data. ([#1761](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1761), [#1720](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1720), [#1645](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1645)) - **Mobile and Connect:** the portfolio refreshes when you return to the mobile app. Connect keeps you signed in when subscription access pauses sync. Mobile navigation and QR scanning are improved. ([#1803](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1803), [#1702](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1702), [#1808](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1808), [#1711](https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/pull/1711)) - **Dates and regions:** portfolio and planning dates follow your selected timezone. Switzerland is now available as a formatting region. name: v3.8.0
body: 3.8 focuses on fixes to cash balances, net worth, spending totals, imports, and retirement calculations. It also includes activity-list improvements, new planning options, and three additional languages. > [!WARNING] > **Back up your database before updating.** Go to **Settings → Backup & Export → Backup Database** and save the file somewhere safe. > > On first launch, 3.8 migrates older transactions so their amount represents the **final cash paid or received, including fees and taxes**. This can change historical cash balances and returns. **The app does not create an automatic backup for this migration.** > > After updating, check **Activities → Needs review** and confirm any flagged transactions against your records. If you use device sync, update all your devices before adding or editing transactions. ## Improvements and additions ### Spending and activity lists - **List performance.** Spending and investment lists load as you scroll and render only the rows in view. - **Filtered and selected totals.** See net totals for filtered or selected spending transactions. Foreign currencies have separate totals, with a converted total when rates are available. - **Foreign-currency entries.** Record a cash transaction in another currency and enter its exchange rate. - **Amount-based rules.** Categorize transactions by amount, including exact values, limits, and ranges. A new Swedish preset covers common local merchants. - **Mobile controls.** Status filters and selection controls are available on mobile. Edit and delete actions work on tablets without hover. (#1429, #1567, #1599, #1627; addresses #1427, #1576) ### Retirement planning Set a pension fund's payout rate. Choose an annuity or a drawdown fund that keeps its remaining balance invested and stops paying when it runs out. The planner reports the projected depletion age. Fund previews and projections now use consistent return assumptions after fees. Negative returns and comma-decimal inputs also work correctly. (#1531, #1539, #1541, #1543, #1555) Lean and Fat FIRE targets now use lower or higher planned spending while keeping pension income and other assumptions in the calculation. Projection labels now describe simulated outcomes and their assumptions. Card spacing has been adjusted for smaller screens. (#1674) ### Languages and regional formatting Added **Italian**, **Brazilian Portuguese**, and **Traditional Chinese**. New formatting regions include Italy, Brazil, Portugal, and Taiwan. This release also improves financial translations, locale-aware name sorting, and Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text entry. Choosing a character no longer triggers an early submit or closes an editor. (#1533, #1566, #1588, #1589, #1605, #1634, #1662) ### Asset logos The bundled logos have been replaced with smaller curated images. Logo matching now takes the market and instrument type into account. You can also now upload a custom asset logo, preview it, or reset it to the default. (#1554, #1631, #1654) ### Other improvements - **Account selection:** keep the same account or portfolio selected as you move between Insights, Holdings, and Income. Performance adds it as a comparison. The selection lasts until you close or reload the app. (#1598) - **Dashboard holdings:** choose Unrealized P&L from the Show menu. Gain sorting follows that choice, and the app remembers your preference. (#1669, addresses #1623) - **App launcher:** the search field is wider, and the layout no longer changes height while filtering. (#1674) - **Activity review:** see broker review reasons, reclassify unknown transactions, and edit credits and cash or security adjustments. (#1527, #1614) - **Rebalancing:** choose which holdings may receive new purchases in Cash Flow Only mode. (#1486, closes #1141) - **Asset details:** edit contract multipliers and bond terms. Transaction-based holdings recalculate; broker holdings refresh on the next sync. Existing manual and CSV snapshots are not rescaled. (#1595) - **Custom data providers:** JSON API sources now support POST requests and more date placeholders. (#1354) - **Add-ons:** new APIs for translations, historical exchange rates, and spending rules. Shared controls now show translated labels. Nested modules load consistently across platforms, and permission controls remain reachable. (#1276, #1511, #1513, #1536, #1542, #1548, #1640, #1659) ## Fixes ### Transaction amounts and cash balances Cash balances now use each transaction's final amount, including fees and taxes. Previously, recalculating that amount from quantity and price could produce a different total and cause cash balances to drift. Forms show a calculated total. You can edit it to match your statement. Imports and broker sync use the same rules. Totals that cannot be verified are flagged for review. For deposits, withdrawals, and cash transfers, enter the actual amount moved. A separate fee field is informational; it is not deducted again. (#1571, fixes #1334) ### Other fixes - **Net worth:** negative cash now reduces the total correctly. New balances show “New” instead of misleading percentages. The breakdown adapts to narrow cards and large values. (#1458, #1660, #1668) - **Privacy:** Hide amounts now covers activity lists and details, dashboard share counts, allocation details, and composition tooltips. (#1664) - **Spending insights:** category totals cover the full period, not just loaded transactions. Date ranges, daily pace, currency labels, and dashboard links are more consistent. Long notes stay within the list. (#1569, #1583, #1650, #1667) - **Holdings and allocations:** remove tiny cash remnants displayed as zero, respect cash-row sorting, retain account names and chart labels, and include unclassified portions in category drill-downs. Country classification is more precise, and shortcuts let you choose the specific instrument type. (#1496, #1498, #1502, #1503, #1507, #1508, #1520) - **Imports:** date detection checks the whole column for day/month order. Reimporting older exported trades no longer creates duplicates because their totals changed during migration. (#1601, #1625) - **Performance:** remove false warnings on days without cash flows and when cash and security transfers both have exact values. Recognized imported FX conversion pairs within one account no longer count as contributions. (#1493, #1655, #1665; fixes #1609) - **Valuation dates:** alternative assets show their Last Updated date. Valuation and quote dates keep the saved calendar day when displayed or edited across time zones. (#1672, #1673; fixes #1670) - **Quotes:** crypto prices update on weekends. Manually priced assets work in benchmark comparisons. Uncertain exchange mappings receive an additional check. (#1540, #1610, #1646) - **Reliability:** portfolio recalculation continues with cached quotes when market sync fails. Out-of-range cash calculations are handled without crashing the cash pipeline. Device pairing checks snapshot schema compatibility. (#1595, #1633, #1642) - **Self-hosted sign-in:** OIDC refreshes signing keys after a verification failure, so provider key rotation no longer requires a server restart. (#1611) - **Interface and desktop:** dialogs contain long text and translated buttons. macOS content clears the window controls. Menu-bar visibility survives restart. Web app icons and Windows source checkouts are fixed. (#1323, #1581, #1607, #1639, #1653, #1658) ## Thanks Thanks to @AlexanderBabel, @blastik, @charlie890414, @DamienKCorp, @fmaass, @guerrantif, @hungchihsueh, @Jonjon-prog, @kryofin, @loreboldo, @marcoscale98, @MobilettoSoft, @Neallin-917, @nimula, @otherness, @rwgs, and @thibaultserti for contributing. And to everyone who reported a bug or helped test a fix. 💛 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.7.0...v3.8.0

name: v3.7.0
body: 3.7.0 adds **closed positions and cash** to the holdings table, ships **Japanese and Korean** locales, **separates UI language from regional formatting**, and **rebuilds the add-on runtime** so add-ons load on WebKit and iOS. Broker sync reads contract multipliers exactly and no longer confuses share-class suffixes with exchange suffixes. The AI assistant gets an explicit financial-safety boundary. > [!WARNING] > **Minimum versions changed.** Wealthfolio now requires **iOS/iPadOS 16**, **macOS 12**, and **Chrome/Edge 107**, **Firefox 104**, or **Safari 16**+. On macOS 12, apply current system and Safari updates so the built-in WebView meets the Safari 16 floor. Existing add-ons keep working; add-ons using the new `ctx.assets` API must declare `minWealthfolioVersion: 3.7.0`, and live development needs `@wealthfolio/addon-dev-tools` 3.7.0+. ## ✨ Highlights ### 💼 Holdings — open, closed, and cash in one place A persistent **Open / Closed** view control sits before the search box (Open stays the default), and **Cash** moved into the Type taxonomy so it filters like any other asset type, with its portfolio weight shown on desktop and mobile. The closed view is tailored to closed positions: **disposed cost basis, sale proceeds, realized P&L, and realized return** instead of market-value columns — including option-expiry disposals, which were previously filtered out of realized results. Closed positions stay distinct from open ones for the same asset even when long and short net to zero, and remain searchable by instrument name. Quantity labels are now instrument-aware: **units** for ETFs and mutual funds (_parts_, _Anteile_, _participaciones_, 口, 좌, 份), **bonds** for debt securities, **contracts** for options, **shares** for stocks. _Thanks to @DamienKCorp._ (#1417, #1487, #1492, #1474, #1480, #1491) ### 🌍 Japanese and Korean — 7 languages total Complete community-contributed **日本語** and **한국어** locales, all 20 namespaces at 100% coverage, matching the existing fr/de/es/zh parity. _Thanks to @shiv3 and @moduvoice._ (#1432, #1278) ### 🔤 UI language separated from regional formatting Language and regional formatting are now independent settings under **Settings → Language & Region**. UI text and control labels follow the **UI language**; numbers, currency, dates, times, and calendars follow the **Region & formats** setting. Eleven options ship (System plus CA, US, GB, FR, DE, ES, MX, CN, JP, KR) with a live preview; **System** resolves the OS/browser locale, so regions without an explicit entry are still covered. Date order (`dd/MM/yyyy` vs `MM/dd/yyyy`) and 12h/24h time follow the selected region. Also supported: system locales outside the bundled date-fns set, native digits, and non-Gregorian calendar round trips (Persian, Thai). Also in this pass: locale policy propagated into add-on sandboxes, locale-aware parsing so comma-decimal input and machine-formatted currency paste survive commit, and localization gaps closed across portfolio, activity, goals, spending, assistant, onboarding, settings, and performance surfaces. Net Worth period labels and category names, retirement planner labels, dashboard goal cards, and the activity search placeholder are translated. _Thanks to @DamienKCorp._ (#1488, #1463, #1466, #1471, closes #246, #1464, #1465) ### 🧩 Add-on runtime rebuilt — origin-independent sandbox The add-on sandbox is now **origin-independent**: its runtime bootstraps from parent-delivered Blob resources instead of origin-specific child requests, which fixes the **WebKit/iOS add-on loading regression** (supersedes #1321). Add-ons get a **private, per-add-on, content-addressed asset registry** for images, fonts, media, config, and Wasm; packaged CSS URLs are rewritten with spec-based CSSTree tokenization; sandboxed ticker avatars are preserved; and development packages publish as immutable generations so reloads can't mix bytes from two builds. Existing 3.6 JS/CSS add-ons remain supported. Direct sandbox networking, remote CSS imports, workers, service workers, and popups remain intentionally unavailable. (#1431) ### 🔗 Broker sync accuracy - **Exact contract multipliers.** Multipliers are deserialized from the cloud holdings contract, persisted canonically on the shared asset, and captured per position snapshot — so futures, CFDs, and non-standard option contracts are valued correctly. Legacy `is_mini_option` fallbacks (10/100) are preserved, and ordinary 1× equities never trigger metadata writes. The account's configured tracking mode is sent on holdings and activity requests for privacy-safe aggregate broker-quality metrics only. (#1433) - **One asset identity per instrument.** A broker instrument could be filed twice — once from the activity path, once from holdings — so transaction-derived and broker-reported holdings never reconciled. Two causes, both found against a live connection: the MIC disagreed between paths (`NEOE` isn't an ISO MIC; `.NE`/`NEO` → `XNEO`), and a **share-class suffix was mistaken for a venue suffix** — BMO's `ZAAA.F` hedged unit class was filed as the unhedged listing, a genuinely different fund quoted ~3% apart. Both paths now resolve identity from the API `symbol`, and a new `parse_symbol_with_known_exchange` keeps a suffix on the ticker when it names a venue the instrument can't be trading on. _Thanks to @rwgs._ (#1424) ### 🤖 AI assistant financial safety policy `system_prompt.txt` is now the single versioned live prompt (the unused JSON/template catalog is gone), with the actual prompt, provider, model, and tool scope persisted in thread snapshots. The financial-decision boundary is explicit: user-authored requests still produce editable activity drafts, while **attachment contents and tool output are treated as untrusted data** and cannot authorize drafts. CSV attachments keep the existing automatic import-preview flow. Persistence requires explicit confirmation in the review UI. Adds safety eval fixtures and response-rubric grading. (#1489) ## 🔧 Improvements - **Auto-redirect to SSO** when OIDC is the only login method, with a one-shot per-tab guard that fails closed so a failed round-trip lands on the login page with the manual button instead of looping. _Thanks to @fmaass._ (#1446, closes #1343) - **Rebalance planner stays reachable in-band.** The "Review rebalance →" CTA renders whenever a handler is wired, not only when a category is out of band — drift is computed on invested value, so idle cash never produces drift and the planner was unreachable in the case cash-flow-only planning targets. _Thanks to @fmaass._ (#1445, closes #1444) - **Spending rule account scope.** The documented Applies To scope was backend-complete but had no UI control, so every UI-created rule was global and assistant-created scoped rules were invisible and un-editable. Frontend-only fix, no schema change. _Thanks to @kryofin._ (#1353, closes #1350) - **Australia and New Zealand spending presets** — 37 rules each, written against real local statement shorthand (`WOOLIES`, `WW METRO`, `MACCAS`, `PAK'N SAVE`). _Thanks to @Hysterelius._ (#1345) - **Mobile finance views.** Horizontal touch scrolling restored for spending categories; liability value history replaced with a responsive mobile list and inline editor while the desktop grid stays. Desktop editing locks during persistence, duplicate dates are rejected, and same-day replacements serialize as delete-then-save. (#1478) - **Onboarding preferences and appearance layouts** are denser and more consistent. (#1500) ## 🐛 Fixes - **Returns for accounts with a negative opening prefix.** The first-activity valuation introduced in 3.6.3 can be negative before the covering deposit (e.g. a trade before T+2 settlement), which made both TWR and value return unavailable for the entire period. A contiguous leading negative prefix is now skipped before compounding starts, and transaction-mode value return rebases on the first observation with at least one base-currency unit. Genuine transitions into negative value stay fatal. (#1443, fixes #1425) - **Credit/refund accounting.** A refund could reduce spending while still counting as portfolio gain. `metadata.flow.is_external` is now the authoritative boundary for CREDIT activities across performance classification and holdings net contribution, preserved through broker sync, manual create/edit, bulk save, duplication, and CSV import — with explicit controls in the activity grid and CSV review. No migration; existing activities keep their subtype defaults. (#1449, fixes #1403) - **Allocation "Unknown" residual.** Look-through ETFs whose provider breakdown sums to slightly under 100% (the dropped `other` sleeve) produced an "Unknown" category containing already-classified holdings — reproducible with VOO/VTI/VXUS. Tiny residuals are now absorbed into AUTO asset-class assignments. _Thanks to @kryofin._ (#1447, fixes #1439) - **Phantom $0 rows in Net Worth.** Fully liquidated accounts keep ~1e-15 residual balances; `round_dp` now runs **before** the zero and sign tests at all three cash-like emit sites, removing phantom rows from both Cash and Liabilities. _Thanks to @kryofin._ (#1460, fixes #1459) - **Foreign-currency account gain display.** A resolved account-to-base FX rate is carried through the current account valuation; the gain amount renders in the account currency only when that rate is valid, preserving the percentage rather than mislabeling an amount. _Thanks to @Neallin-917._ (#1436, fixes #1426) - **Retirement/goal money fields** are seeded and scaled in the account's base currency instead of raw USD numbers relabeled, and text inputs are no longer clamped to the slider's USD-scale ceiling. _Thanks to @nofanto._ (#1476, fixes #1475) - **Holding details overlapping performance.** Long localized quantity text could overflow the shrinkable column and paint over the fixed performance column. _Thanks to @Neallin-917._ (#1442, fixes #1438) - **Cash pseudo-type vs Cash Balance taxonomy.** The synthetic cash filter reused the real `CASH` taxonomy key, collapsing two distinct holding types. (#1500) - **Table sorting survives view changes.** DataTable pruned unavailable sort columns and persisted the fallback, permanently losing the preferred sorting. (#1500) - **Account selection** reflects programmatic form updates (AccountSelect was uncontrolled), and long account dropdowns are height-constrained. (#1500) - **Holdings quantity label casing** — a dedicated inline `shares_label` keeps unit descriptors lowercase without breaking locale grammar or the title-cased column heading. (#1491) - **Deps:** `yahoo_finance_api` upgraded to 4.2 (retry and request-handling fixes), obsolete direct dependency and error conversion removed from `core` (#1500); `nanoid` patched to 3.3.18 / 5.1.16 (#1478). ## 📦 Platform - **iOS/iPadOS 16** is the new minimum deployment target (raised from 14 → 15 → 16 across #1423 and #1431), ahead of App Store Connect's Spring 2027 requirement. - **Browser/OS floors:** Chrome/Edge 107, Firefox 104, Safari/WKWebView 16, macOS 12. ## 🙏 Thanks To @shiv3 and @moduvoice for the Japanese and Korean locales, and to @DamienKCorp, @kryofin, @fmaass, @Neallin-917, @rwgs, @nofanto, and @Hysterelius for the fixes and features in this release. 💛 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.6.3...v3.7.0

name: v3.6.3
body: A stability release. No new surface area, just making the app fast, light and correct on large portfolios with long histories. > **First launch will take longer than usual.** A one-time migration rebuilds derived data and rewrites the database file to reclaim disk space. Let it finish before closing the app. ### Performance & stability - **Valuation no longer spikes memory.** Long histories were expanded into dense daily clones before valuation, which could push the app out of memory. Valuation now walks a sparse keyframe timeline, batches quotes, and bounds concurrent recalculation. (#1412) - **Performance statistics no longer time out.** Transfer economics come straight from the asset instead of being rebuilt through daily snapshots, and identical cold calculations are coalesced. (#1347, #1398) - **Databases shrink roughly 8×.** Snapshots were re-serializing the full `lots` array already stored in the `lots` table, about 89% of file size on large instances. A `VACUUM` returns the space to the filesystem. One real 356 MiB database came out at 79 MiB. _Thanks @atsoc0ocsav._ (#1218, #1387) - **SQLite tuning:** larger cache and mmap, `temp_store = MEMORY`, a composite index on `activities(account_id, activity_date)`, and `ANALYZE` after migrations. _Thanks @atsoc0ocsav._ (#1218) - **Imports are validated before they are applied**, unsupported dates are rejected, and one skipped account no longer blocks the rest. (#1412) ### Fixes - **Holdings-mode deposits counted as gains.** Snapshot-tracked accounts record no activities, so a 300K deposit showed as a +300K period gain. External flows are now inferred by pricing both snapshots at the transition day's quotes, so only user-made changes remain. Net contribution, device sync and add-on semantics are unchanged. (#1418) - **Dashboards failed on quote gaps.** Days where no position had a usable quote were dropped, and scoped aggregation then rejected the history as an interior gap. Those days now emit a row marked unpriced. _Thanks @Jonjon-prog._ (#1022) - **Rebalance targets sized against a stale total** on taxonomies without a cash category: the top-up bought more of already-overweight sleeves and the After column summed above 100%. _Thanks @FlyingDuck._ (#1248, #1249) - **CSV imports stored a blank currency** on asset-backed rows when the file had no currency column, breaking FX conversion later. The account currency is now backfilled, and a Health Center check deep-links already-affected activities. (#1388, #1410) - **`POST /api/v1/activities/bulk` validated every row against the first row's account**, rejecting valid rows and silently accepting forbidden ones depending on row order. _Thanks @kryofin._ (#1356, #1357) - **Cash dividend and interest edits failed** on quantity/price fields that are hidden in cash mode, on desktop and mobile. (#1413) - **Holdings-mode account pages** now open on Snapshots instead of Activities, and snapshot history no longer shows Cash as 0. (#1413) - **Whole-period TWR was nulled by dormant days** with a sub-unit denominator. Those days now pause compounding; genuinely fatal reasons still null it. _Thanks @atsoc0ocsav._ (#1218) - **Custom provider prices in BRL** (`R$ 1.234,56`) now parse. _Thanks @bergomel._ (#1381, #1390) - **Logs no longer contain quantities or stored amounts.** ### Improvements - **Average cost line on the holding chart**, folded into the existing buy/sell marker toggle and persisted across reloads. Hidden for closed positions. _Thanks @Baykenn._ (#1370) ### Add-ons - **Navigation stays above add-on views.** Opening an add-on on iOS or in floating/mobile layouts hid the nav bar behind the iframe, which also swallowed pointer input. (#1273, #1313, #1315) - **Add-on content clears the bottom navigation**, so controls at the bottom of a page are reachable. No changes needed in installed add-ons or the SDK. (#1383) ### Security - **26 of 28 open Dependabot advisories cleared** via direct upgrades, with three `pnpm.overrides` removed rather than added. Notable: `hono` 4.13.1, `undici` 7.29.0, `ip-address` 10.4.0, `react-router` 7.18.2, `diesel` 2.3.12. (#1416) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.6.2...v3.6.3

name: v3.6.2
body: A correctness release: improved portfolio returns and tax/split/dividend accounting, plus fixes for issues after the major add-on platform overhaul. ### Fixes - **Holding returns now exclude FX.** Cross-currency transferred securities could report inflated returns (e.g. +120%) by folding exchange-rate movement into security performance. Return % is now computed in holding currency. (#1277) - **Dividend-adjusted history fixed** for MarketData.app — its adjusted closes were double-counting separately booked dividend cash activities, overstating returns. Run a full market-data backfill to correct stored history. (#1284) - **Split-adjusted valuations now shared across accounts** — a split entered in any account corrects historical valuation for every account that held the asset, including ones that sold before the split. (#1286) - **Tax now deducts from cash balance for all cash activity types** (Credit, Deposit, Withdrawal, cash transfers), fixing dashboard/account balances that were off by the tax amount. (#1268) - **Contribution limits handle units-based transfers** — a `TRANSFER_IN` with quantity/price but no stored amount no longer breaks the deposits calculation. (#1250) - **Health Center sell-proceeds check** now matches the holdings calculator, removing false positives on taxed sells. Some dismissed "missing lot disposal" warnings resurface once after upgrade (intended). (#1289) - **Health price-sync retries** behave consistently across desktop and web; empty history is treated as a neutral no-data skip instead of accumulating errors. (#740) - **FEE/TAX activity value** no longer displays 0 for tax-only activities — the frontend now mirrors the backend charge precedence. (#1290) - **Price precision cleaned up** — regular prices drop floating-point tails (`268.3999939` → `268.40`) while sub-cent prices and average costs keep up to 8 decimals; custom-provider Unicode keys parse correctly; Quotes tab renamed **Price History**. (#1287) - **Non-ASCII symbol search no longer panics** on Nordic/Arabic/CJK/emoji input. (#1234) - **Market-data API key input** stays bound while typing/pasting a first-time key. (#1253) - **"Where it went"** dashboard widget now shows a distinct Saving row. _Thanks @Jonjon-prog._ (#1279) - **AI provider permissions can be reset again** — re-enabling deselected permissions is no longer silently ignored. (#1300) - **Onboarding Connect links** open reliably in the desktop app; self-hosters can opt into the MCP endpoint with `WF_MCP_ENABLED=true`. (#1300) ### Add-ons - **Platform overhaul** completing the 3.6 sandbox model (#1260): durable per-addon SQLite storage (replacing the broken `localStorage` pattern, device-synced), manifest-first lazy lifecycle (`contributes.routes`/`links`, nav built without executing addon code), host-owned render root, baseline capabilities dropped from the consent prompt, self-hosted auth-gate parity, and legible sandbox error toasts. - **Basic auth** for brokered network requests (`auth: { type: 'basic' }`) — enables APIs like SimpleFin Bridge. (#1274) - **Safe module-import rewriting** via `es-module-lexer`, fixing host calls like `activities.import(...)` being mangled. (#1275) - **Device-identity refactor** — the persistent install ID is dropped from public settings and the addon SDK; addons using `Settings.instanceId` must stop relying on it. (#1270) ### Internationalization - **Activity type/subtype names** now localized in badges, tables, filters, import, and the AI tool. _Thanks @FlyingDuck._ (#1243) - **Interval selector labels** (`1D`/`1W`/…/`ALL`) now localized. _Thanks @FlyingDuck._ (#1242) - **Non-Latin category creation fixed** (e.g. `贵金属`, `عقارات`) — no longer silently fails. _Thanks @FlyingDuck._ (#1247) - **Spain (`es`) spending categorization preset** added alongside US/CA/GB. _Thanks @blastik._ **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.6.1...v3.6.2

name: v3.6.1
body: # Wealthfolio 3.6.1 ### Fixes - **Add-on sandbox now loads on Windows.** WebView2 (Chromium) enforces `frame-ancestors`, which `'none'` was silently blocking — every add-on failed with a sandbox load timeout. Relaxed to `'self'` so the app can frame its own sandbox document while still preventing foreign framing. (#1231) - **Provider quotes prioritized over broker fallbacks** for more accurate pricing. (#1231) - **Add-on sandbox background tracks the live host theme** — no more stale dark background after the app resolves its real theme. (#1236) - **Health Center issues are now localized.** Titles and messages render in your selected language via stable issue codes + params (27 codes), instead of always English. (#1223) - **Relaxed the stale-price health warning threshold** so normal quote gaps no longer trigger a warning. (#1235) - Added MCP support for applying reviewed asset classification drafts, including a new `classification:write` scope, targeted UI refresh after external classification updates, and safer audit redaction for classification commit requests. ### Add-ons - **New duotone-Phosphor sidebar icon set** — a curated, typed vocabulary of 80 add-on icons (`AddonIconName`) with compile-time validation and autocomplete, replacing the old ~20-entry map. Unknown names fall back to a caret-right icon. (#1236) - **v3.5 → v3.6 sandbox migration guide** added, plus Addon SDK **3.6.1** changelog. (#1231, #1236) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.6.0...v3.6.1

name: v3.6.0
body: # Wealthfolio 3.6.0 Wealthfolio now speaks **5 languages**, opens up to **AI agents** over the Model Context Protocol, adds **OIDC single sign-on** for self-hosters, and ships **short positions**, **activity taxes**, **reimbursements & split transactions**, a smarter **rebalancer**, and a rebuilt **Health Center**. ## ✨ Highlights ### 🌍 Internationalization — 5 languages The entire frontend is now translated into **English, Français, Deutsch, Español, and 简体中文** (20 namespaces, full parity), and the backend Health Center is locale-aware. Language is an explicit stored setting selectable in **Settings → Language & Region** and during onboarding, with localized date pickers/formatting. (#1217) ### 🤖 AI Agent Access — MCP server (desktop + web) A new Model Context Protocol server lets external AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) read and act on your portfolio on **both runtimes** — the Tauri desktop app (embedded loopback server) and the Axum web server (`/mcp`). Access is gated by **scoped Personal Access Tokens**, every tool call is **audited**, and all access flows through the running app — no direct database access. Tools cover holdings, portfolios, net worth, contribution limits, and CSV import (get mapping / prepare / commit). Configure under **Settings → AI Agent Access**. (#1183) ### 🔐 Optional OIDC SSO for the web server Self-hosters can sign in via any OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, PocketID, Authelia, Keycloak, …), instead of or alongside the shared password. OIDC is authentication-only and converges on the same `wf_session` cookie as password login. (#1182, closes #592) ### 📉 Explicit short position tracking Signed-lot support for **stock/ETF and option** shorts. Open with *Sell Short*, close with *Buy to Cover*; options support open/close intent and broker aliases (BTO/STO/BTC/STC). Plain sells never auto-open a short. Intent is preserved through CSV import and broker sync. (#1194, #1197) ### 🧾 Activity-level tax support Record tax directly on trade and income activities. Tax flows through snapshot, holdings, lot disposal, valuation, and performance calculations, and is exposed in forms, data grids, import mapping, addon SDK types, and E2E coverage. (#1198, #1202) ### 💸 Reimbursements & split transactions Reimbursements (`CREDIT + REIMBURSEMENT`) are treated as contra-expense against spending. Transactions can be split across **multiple categories**, with budgets, analytics, insights, and event summaries allocating by split line. (#1192) ### ⚖️ Rebalancer Phase 2 Generic **sell constraints** (`do_not_sell` per asset, `avoid_selling` per account), a **turnover cap**, and **plan explanations** — persisted and device-synced. Stacked bars reordered to **Now → After → Target** for immediate before/after comparison. _Thanks to @Jonjon-prog._ (#1177, #1176) ### 🩺 Redesigned Health Center Rebuilt around a simpler diagnostic model with stable fingerprints, domain/level/severity, evidence, and ordered fix/navigate actions — and now fully localized. (#1215) ## 🔧 Improvements - **Pin add-ons to your navigation.** Add-ons with a page can now be pinned to the sidebar, floating bar, and mobile nav from **Settings → Add-ons** for one-tap access. (#1216) - **Add-on runtime refactor.** The add-on sandbox was hardened with brokered route rendering, theme propagation, CSS asset support, and host-owned loading/error states — no more light-page flash on navigation, and consistent nav/pin behavior across desktop and mobile. (#1216) - **Holdings & performance UI:** Realized P&L column, Book cost cell in the overview strip, IRR relabeled to **MWR (money-weighted return)**, and a regrouped desktop metric strip (Returns / Risk / Total) with clearer help and warning indicators. (#1186, #1195) - **Activity form** redesigned into grouped card sections. (#1188) - **Navigation style** picker (sidebar / floating bar) in Onboarding and Settings → Appearance. - **Add-on sandbox** hardened: brokered route rendering, theme propagation, CSS asset support, host-owned loading/error states, consistent nav/pinning. (#1216) ## 🐛 Fixes - **Broker sync:** merge duplicate per-lot position rows into one holding — fixes accounts (notably Fidelity via SnapTrade) showing ~half their real value. (#1185) - **ETF asset-class auto-classification** restored. (#1116) - **Import currency resolution/precedence:** a USD-quoted security imported into a non-USD account keeps its own quote currency; quote-unit currencies like GBp preserved. (#1199, #1205, #1206) - **Quote-unit asset lots** (GBp/GBX) display in the correct currency across lots, income, and P&L. (#1208) - **Import date validation:** month-name dates like `Nov-02-2023` no longer pass review then fail at import. (#1193, #1196) - **Composition chart** treemap labels readable in dark mode. (#1201, #1209) - **Mobile:** compact account detail tabs and single-line Net Worth breakdown deltas. (#1180) ## 🙏 Thanks To our community contributors and translators — especially @Jonjon-prog — and everyone whose translation work (#416, #845, #210) fed into this release. 💛 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.5.3...v3.6.0

name: v3.5.3
body: ## What's Changed This release adds a per-account Activities tab, holdings export, hybrid drift bands, and cash-as-fixed-income classification, then fixes net-worth history, performance/FX, multi-currency dashboards, dashboard speed, CSV imports, custom providers, Spending, mobile, and Linux Connect deep links found after `v3.5.2`. ## Highlights ### Account Activities - Added an **Activities tab** to account detail pages, reusing the existing activity tables with inline edit/delete, plus an account-filtered **`Explore activities`** link with pagination. - Refined the account header (`Group › Account` on desktop, name-only on mobile), hid the redundant Holdings heading, and hid the contribution-limit prompt when no current-year limit is configured. ### Holdings Export - Added a **holdings data export** (core export module + server endpoint + desktop command), available from **Settings → Exports**. ### Allocation & Rebalancing - Added **hybrid drift bands** with per-sleeve tolerance — `band = max(target_bps × relative_factor, absolute_floor)`, defaulting to 20% relative + 1% floor. Existing absolute targets are unchanged (no silent migration), and drift notation switched from `pp` to `%`. - Added an **asset-class override for cash accounts**, so a HYSA / Cash ISA / Livret A / CD can be classified as fixed income instead of always charting as "Cash". - Fixed allocation drift-tolerance display, cash allocation detail rows, and detail category switching. ### Dashboard & Performance - Reworked dashboard performance loading with a **lightweight profile** for account/group rows (preserving TWR for transaction-mode summaries), bounded parallelism, and retained prior values to reduce flicker; unavailable-metric reasons now link to the Health Center (#1171). - Added a **lean holdings list endpoint** used across the holdings table, account/asset pages, and retirement planner for faster loads. - Fixed the dashboard showing **base currency for foreign-currency accounts** (inverted `displayInAccountCurrency` condition), while preserving foreign-account warnings (#1125). ### Holdings, Net Worth & History - Fixed **hidden accounts being dropped** from Total and portfolio history — hidden (non-archived) accounts now stay in aggregate/history scopes (#1140). - Fixed **split-adjusted valuation history** by applying split factors to price instead of mutating historical quantities; preserved alternative assets in net worth (#1140). - Fixed **synthetic holdings history backfill** — stopped generating synthetic snapshots for manual/CSV/broker holdings, ignored legacy `SYNTHETIC` snapshots, and render single-point histories with a real chart dot (#1105). - Added a **scoped current valuation read model** so current-value surfaces use the latest snapshot, quotes, and FX instead of stale daily valuation rows (#1101). ### Performance & FX - Made performance semantics explicit — typed transfer boundary classification, valuation quality/status metadata, and FX book cost anchored to lot acquisition instead of valuation-date FX (#1119, #1142). - Fixed an **FX rate of "1"** persisted when adding a provider-sourced pair on a weekend (#1143). ### CSV Import & Custom Providers - Fixed **cash-only holdings CSV imports** being blocked at Review Assets (#1111, #897). - Raised the **symbol length cap 20 → 100** and allowed underscores in import symbols (#1145). - Allowed **ISIN-only custom provider sources** and fixed bond ISIN overrides saved with a symbol (#1005, #1107). - Fixed an **invalid UTF-8 boundary panic** in the custom provider on CJK/emoji content. ### Spending & Budgets - Surfaced **backend error messages** when a budget group delete fails (#1130). - Fixed mobile spending transaction flow, period selector alignment, event tag summaries, and stable user-facing broker-sync messages (#1099). ### Mobile - Fixed the **iOS viewport gap** so the app uses the full screen on iPhone (#1170). - Replaced the squeezed desktop popover with a **mobile bottom sheet** for custom performance date ranges (#1133). - Fixed **mobile activity filters not applying** after selection. ### Wealthfolio Connect (Linux) - Fixed **Connect auth deep links on Linux**. - Refactored post-login sync bootstrap and fixed activity action/filter reset and addon permission category detection. ## Resolved Issues #1140, #1105, #1101, #1142, #1119, #1143, #1125, #1111, #897, #1145, #1107, #1005, #1130, #1099, #1133, #1170 ## Contributors - @afadil - @Jonjon-prog - @eldossjogy - @zephyros-dev made their first contribution in #1106 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wealthfolio/wealthfolio/compare/v3.5.2...v3.5.3

Added manual transfer linking and unlinking from Spending and Investment activity rows. - Added a transfer match dialog with suggestions, search, filters, warnings, and explicit confirmation. - Improved repair flows for broken or invalid transfer links. -
